item.reason: Primary target file for this story. Currently has 9 devices, needs expansion to 40+.
Service that loads devices.json. Defines DeviceProfile interface used throughout app.
Zustand store with DeviceProfile interface. May need alignment with deviceConfig.ts types.
Contains 13 chipset folders with firehose files. Devices.json URLs must reference these folders.

constraints.constraint: Device schema must match DeviceProfile interface in src/services/deviceConfig.ts with fields: id, brand, name, codename, chipset, chipsetName, status, authMethod, presetId, firehose
Firehose URLs must use GitHub raw content pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XuanNguyenNB/Q-Flash-Web/main/public/firehose/{FOLDER}/{FILENAME}
Each device must have unique id field (use pattern: brand_model like oneplus_12)
Mark devices as 'coming' if not personally tested to maintain data integrity
